# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 50 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 39 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_050_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 50

**1** Jesus said: "If they say to you, 'Where did you come from?' say to them, 'We have come from the light [оуоєін], from the place where the light came into being on its own accord and established itself and appeared in their image [хіконе].'

**2** If they say to you, 'Is it you?' say, 'We are its children [шнре], and we are the chosen of the living Father.'

**3** If they ask you, 'What is the sign [маеін] of your Father in you?' say to them, 'It is movement and rest [мтон].'"

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *оуоєін*: light; the divine origin is light
- "Established itself" — the light is self-originating and self-establishing
- *хіконе*: image, icon — the light appeared in their image (= in the image of the disciples)
- *маеін*: sign; Greek loan-word σημεῖον — the sign/proof of the Father's presence
- *мтон*: rest; the paired movement and rest is the sign
- This is a catechetical passage — structured as Q&A responses for hostile interrogation
- The "movement and rest" is the ultimate description of the divine life within; the Father is both active and at rest

---
